messages:
Maria S.: FYI CI is spiking with failures hitting the mock session-store. multiple integraton jobs timeout around the same call (~08:10 UTC).
Kevin L.: Re-ran a couple, same hang on session get, doesn't fail fast, just stalls.
Sophie (eng): Which test? can you paste the failing step?
Maria S.: integration/session_expiry_test -> step 'create session, fetch after ttl'
ci-bot: Job failed: https://ci.redwood/integrations/4821 — exit code 1 — logs attached :link: 
Maria S.: log excerpt:
```
[session-store] WARN 2026-05-12T08:10:21Z request timed out after 30s id=abcd1234
integration: rpc timeout while waiting for session: context deadline exceeded
connection error: read tcp 10.0.0.5:52342->10.0.0.9:6379: i/o timeout
```
Kevin L.: I ran a curl against the mock image on staging, saw intermittent 502s and delayed replies (100ms->30s).
Sophie (eng): Could be the image change pushed yesterday. Anyone bumped mock-session-store?
Maria S.: I think there was a patch to the keepalive/conn pool in registry:mock-session-store:v2.4.1 yesterday afternoon.
Jordan (oncall): @devops-bot can you tell me which runners hit this?
devops-bot: Affected runners: runner-7, runner-11, runner-3. All in eu-west-1.
Jordan (oncall): I'm going to pin CI config to v2.4.0 for now and trigger reruns.
Kevin L.: If v2.4.1 changed pool behavior that could explain bursty timeouts. pin sounds right.
Sophie (eng): +1. We should also bisect to confirm. Can someone drop the image diff?
Maria S.: quick diff of changelog:
```
v2.4.1: change connection idle timeout default from 5s -> 1s, pool max inflight tweaks
v2.4.0: stable
```
Kevin L.: That matches — lowering idle to 1s can cause more reconnect storms under CI load.
Jordan (oncall): Done: CI now pinned to registry/redwood/mock-session-store:v2.4.0 and I restarted the affected runners. Triggering reruns now.
ci-bot: Rerun started for 6 jobs.
Maria S.: Rerun results: 4/6 green, 2 still failing on runner-3 with same timeout.
Sophie (eng): runner-3 is on older kernel, maybe underlying TCP keepalive behavior. Any network flakiness?
devops-bot: runner-3 packet loss averaged 0.2% in the last hour, higher than others (0.01%).
Jordan (oncall): I'll repro on runner-3 locally and escalate to infra. Opening ticket ENGINFRA-345: investigate runner-3 networking + mock-session-store infra.
Maria S.: Thanks. For now tests are mostly green with the pin. Please don't upgrade mock-session-store in CI until we confirm.
Kevin L.: I'll add a note to the release checklist to include a quick CI smoke harness for mock services.
Sophie (eng): Can someone add the flaky tests to quarantine so they don't block PRs?
Jordan (oncall): Quarantined integration/session_expiry_test on the PR gate until ENGINFRA-345 is resolved.
Maria S.: Awesome. Follow-up: when ENGINFRA-345 is done we'll unpin and run full regression. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Kevin L.: :eyes:
Sophie (eng): filing a short postmortem bullet list in #postmortems later today.
Jordan (oncall): Assigned to me and infra team.
Maria S.: closing thread, reach out if you see reoccurrence.
